## Short story

- [01. The short, long train ride](https://www.soura.org/short-story/01-the-short-long-train-ride.md): Kavi glanced at the book in his lap. He was bored. It was not because of the book. It was because he was unable to read the book. Tales of dense jungles, fierce predators, and brave hunters beckoned to him.
- [02. The jungle lodge](https://www.soura.org/short-story/02-the-jungle-lodge.md): Anita sighed. This boy will send me to an early grave, she thought, but he'll come by to put flowers every day.
- [03. The boy who went up the hill](https://www.soura.org/short-story/03-the-boy-who-went-up-the-hill.md): As he ran, his throat burned. It wasn't quite fire; the icy wind sent chilly needles down his open mouth in perfect, agonizing synchronicity.
- [04. The aftermath](https://www.soura.org/short-story/04-the-aftermath.md): Kavi rested his head against the tree trunk. Just a few minutes, he thought.
- [05. The riverside](https://www.soura.org/short-story/05-the-riverside.md): It was late morning. Kavi stood still, mesmerized by the roaring river. The events of last night had faded, misty and dark now, more insubstantial than a dream.

## Yay-Man

- [Chapter 1: Sunday](https://www.soura.org/yay-man/chapter-1-sunday.md): It was a quiet Sunday evening in Supernagar. Quiet by the megapolis' standards; less than a million were out on the streets, and fewer than half of them were honking.
- [Chapter 2: Monday](https://www.soura.org/yay-man/chapter-2-monday.md): Monday dawned bright and early, as most Mondays seem to do. At 8:30 am, Poltu found himself in his usual seat, next to Rekha. It was English class. Mrs. Chaudhry was explaining to the class how a radish was more whitish than red, while a carrot was more reddish than white.
